▤About Me

Hello I'm Subluxe, I'm a mechanical keyboard enthusiast and former event organizer, originally from Vancouver but I'm based in Nagoya now.

I'm into various MMOs but I mainly play OSRS, MapleStory and Classic Maple.

I also do a bit of writing on the side, and have written for some small projects.
